dice.name: Upstream dice rules
help.title: Verification help
help.verification: This panel checks the migrated PCG streams and dice rules. It cannot run a full DCSS game.
help.start: Enter a seed and start verification to create a deterministic rule state.
help.sample: Generate a sample to advance the selected random-number stream.
help.roll: Set the dice count and sides, then roll to exercise the migrated dice helper.
help.seed: Use a nonnegative whole-number seed. A reset starts the streams from that seed again.
help.save: Save preserves the current stream state. Load resumes it without reseeding.
help.export_import: Export saves as versioned JSON; import only a save from this verification panel.
help.language: Changing display language does not change the rule state or random-number streams.
help.player: Player names are displayed exactly as entered and are never translated.
help.touch: Use the on-screen buttons on a phone or tablet.
help.keyboard: Use Tab to move between fields and buttons, then Enter or Space to activate a button.
help.full_game: Dungeon exploration, combat, items, spells, monsters, and other game systems are outside this milestone.

settings.default_language: Japanese is the default display language.
